notes.note: This was the lowest for Herbert since round 17 with 14 touches for him and just 1 contested.
Herbert couldn't hit triple figures again but still was great with his 21 disposals at 85%. Still a good option
Herbert continues to impress with 34 disposals at 79% for back to back scores in the 130's. A great pick up for those that grabbed him as teams are running out of trades.

Herbert was a huge surprise this week. He has been scoring well but really showed us what he can do with 36 disposals 8 marks and an 86% efficiency rating! He is one that you can play on field where needed but also if you are able to loop him at all then that is a great option.
22 disposals for Herbert in yet another solid score. He is one of the players you could consider looping on to the field where possible.
Herbert was great again this week thanks to 10 marks and his 20 disposals coming at 95% efficiency. He would be a great loop player for you.

Herbert had his lowest score so far from his 19 disposals. He is still making money but you probably don't have the trades left to make the most of it. Importantly he should hold his spot which will see him valuable on your bench.

Herbert's second game was better than his first with his 15 disposals and 6 marks seeing him as the equal second highest scorer for the Eagles. Whilst we won't be using him for cash generation he will be good bench cover.
Herbert had his first game and was impressive as a mid season draftee. 15 disposals 6 marks at 86% will see him another popular downgrade this week.
